author: Alexander Grothendieck
title: Modèles de Néron et monodromie
booktitle: Groupes de monodromie en géométrie algébrique, SGA 7 I
annote: Original printed Exposé IX opened, downloaded and collated with the reused leaves. Seminar 1967--1969, publication 1972: an exact donor-draft match does not mean a result first proved after the 1975 lecture. PDF page equals printed page plus five. Sections 9.4--10.4, 11.3, 11.5, 12.4, 12.9--12.10, 13.1--13.3 and 14.1--14.2 matched. Published 9.7 integrality and 14.1.12 sign questions retained.

author: Henri Cartan
title: Théories cohomologiques
annote: Original full journal volume opened; §7 pp.269--271 explicitly reports Grothendieck lecture 12 December 1975. Comparison range is inclusive in the author’s weight convention; products have binomial factors. Root also checked Theorems1--3 pp.264,266,267 and §6 p.268. Note added in proof p.271 mentions Miller preprint; not a 1978 first-circulation date.

author: Edward Y. Miller
title: De Rham cohomology with arbitrary coefficients
annote: Publication identified by opened Cartan and later primary papers. Cartan’s1976 proof note supplies a pre-1978 circulation bound. Original Miller article was not personally obtained by the middle agent; retain root’s exact access audit if available. No DOI inferred from memory.

author: Norbert Roby
title: Lois polynomes et lois formelles en théorie des modules
journal: Annales scientifiques de l’École Normale Supérieure
annote: Original Numdam paper opened by root, shared source audit. IV.1 polynomial laws and IV.5 free-module invariant tensors support the bounded PD background. Does not automatically check every inhomogeneous super-PD axiom on scan217.

author: Albrecht Dold and Dieter Puppe
title: Homologie nicht-additiver Funktoren. Anwendungen
annote: Original Numdam paper opened by root. Standard simplicial normalization background is distinguished from independent special-case calculations in this dossier; no full reproof of Dold--Puppe is claimed.

author: Lawrence Breen and Roman Mikhailov and Antoine Touzé
title: Derived functors of the divided power functors
annote: Original publisher PDF downloaded and read. Published29February2016. Proposition3.5 p.270, equation(3-9), has finitely generated projective M over a commutative ring and Dold--Puppe derived Γ, Λ and Sym with the stated shifts. Proposition6.6 and Remark6.7 p.288 compare PD Koszul objects. These do not justify naive termwise exterior powers of complexes.

author: Aise Johan de Jong
title: Homomorphisms of Barsotti--Tate groups and crystals in positive characteristic
annote: Author DVI downloaded and decoded with dvitype because direct PDF conversion lacked fonts/prologue and produced blank pages. Corollary1.2 gives full faithfulness over any DVR in characteristic p, without the p-basis hypothesis of F-crystal Theorem1.1. Criterion2.5, not Theorem2.6, concerns good and semistable reduction. Received5December1995, revised14November1997, publishedOctober1998; no earlier first circulation is inferred.

author: Aise Johan de Jong
title: Erratum: Homomorphisms of Barsotti--Tate groups and crystals in positive characteristic
annote: Full author erratum downloaded and decoded. Lemma2.1(iii) is false; Definition2.2 must include the indicated kernel/cokernel being p-divisible groups. The full-faithfulness corollary remains unchanged. Journal volume/page confirmed by bibliography in Milne’s opened author exposition; author file is the checked theorem source.

author: Pierre Cartier
title: Une nouvelle opération sur les formes différentielles
journal: Comptes rendus de l’Académie des sciences de Paris
annote: Author bibliography opened and metadata checked; original note not opened in this run. The elementary polynomial Cartier calculation actually used has a direct proof in mathematical_checks.md. No general derived Cartier theorem is attributed to this bibliographic check.

author: Robert F. Coleman
title: The monodromy pairing
annote: Publisher first-page search excerpt checked; full PDF opening returned403. June2000 publication; received5June1998, accepted23March1999. The excerpt says §2 proves Raynaud/Grothendieck pairing agreement, but its precise hypotheses and signs were not accepted as checked from the excerpt alone.

author: Manuela Stoia
title: Points de Gorenstein d’un morphisme
journal: Comptes rendus de l’Académie des sciences de Paris
annote: Identified by opened Bănică--Stoia1979 bibliography[6] as November1975, volume281. Original published note and pagination not obtained. The supplied donor explicitly attributes the theorem to Manuela Stoia. No date or page range has been guessed.

author: Constantin Bănică and Manuela Stoia
title: Gorenstein points of a flat morphism of complex spaces
annote: Original15-page combined preprint opened; this paper begins PDFpage9, theorem printedp2/PDF10, proper-flat corollary printedp5/PDF13, bibliography PDF15. The analytic statement is distinct from the supplied algebraic Stoia theorem; reference[6] identifies the1975 note.

author: Dennis Sullivan
title: Infinitesimal computations in topology
annote: Original Numdam PDF opened. §5 pp.288--289 add/kill minimal-model algorithm; Theorem8.1 p.301 nilpotent finite-type rational comparison; Theorem10.1 p.307 finite-type nilpotent spaces. The nonnilpotent real statement labelled Theorem8.1-prime pp.303--304 explicitly leaves part(v) incompletely proved. Received30March1977, publication28December1977. Textual similarity does not authenticate author of English donor N27.

author: Bohumil Cenkl
title: Cohomology operations from higher products in the de Rham complex
annote: Original full source opened. Theorem1 p.25 constructs higher products. §5 Theorem2 pp.31--32 assumes natural unit and commutative multiplication, acyclicity on models and a natural cochain comparison inducing isomorphisms for all spaces/all degrees. It forces all squares divisible by2, hence2 invertible. This does not exclude the weighted finite-range manuscript model. Received30September1987, revised9November1988; September1989 publication.

author: Antonio Garvín and Luis Lechuga and Aniceto Murillo and Vicente Muñoz and Antonio Viruel
title: An extension of Miller’s version of the de Rham theorem with any coefficients
annote: Full original8-page paper downloaded by late agent and directly read by middle agent at work/late/Garvin1998.pdf. Proposition3.2 pp.174--175 q-extendability; Remark3.3 p.175 failure of(q+1)-extendability; Theorem4.2 p.176 comparison is STRICT p<q for any simplicial set over a commutative unital ring. Factor q! in the integration normalization is not an inversion in the coefficient ring.

author: Bohumil Cenkl and Richard Porter
title: Cup-i product and higher homotopies in the de Rham complex
annote: Original publisher image PDF downloaded; title and printedpp9--11 visually read. Proposition1 p.10 states strict p<q with Γ_q coefficients and binomial-weighted products. Theorems1--2 p.11 add a DASH/bar-coalgebra extension of integration and wedge-i operations. December1982. Whole21-page proof not independently re-proved.

author: Bohumil Cenkl and Richard Porter
title: De Rham theorem with cubical forms
annote: Original publisher PDF downloaded; §4 and theorem statements read with visual checks printedpp35,44. Theorem4.1 p.44 assumes a finite-type simplicial complex and q≥1, and computes all-degree cohomology with Q_q=Z[1/p:prime p≤q]. Theorem4.2 p.46 compares products across weight sum; Theorem4.3 p.48 is homology. It is a different coefficient model from integral weighted Cartan forms. January1984.

author: William G. Dwyer
title: Tame homotopy theory
annote: Original source was sought by title, DOI, author/publication bibliographies and follow-back citations but not obtained. Exact theorem scope here is cited from opened Scheerer--Tanré1991, not claimed to be a direct reading of Dwyer1979.

author: Hans Scheerer and Daniel Tanré
title: Exploring W. G. Dwyer’s tame homotopy theory
annote: Original primary research article downloaded, introduction pp.376--377 read and visual inequality checked. It recalls Dwyer’s r≥3, s=r−1 comparison, increasing rings R_j with integers k inverted when2k−3≤j, and explicitly no finite-type assumption on simplicial sets. This is a checked later primary exposition, not the original Dwyer paper.

author: Michael A. Mandell
title: E-infinity algebras and p-adic homotopy theory
annote: Author full47-page version downloaded. Main Theorem authorp1: connected p-complete nilpotent finite p-type spaces embed fully contravariantly using E-infinity cochains over algebraic closure of F_p. AppendixA TheoremsA.1--A.2 authorp35 distinguish fields with surjective1−F and finite fields, where maps involve free loop spaces. Not the integral2006 theorem. First circulation not established here.

author: Michael A. Mandell
title: Cochain multiplications
annote: Original article opened and exact axioms/theorems read. Main Theorem p.548 characterizes E-infinity cochain theories satisfying homotopy, excision, disjoint-union/product and dimension axioms. Uniqueness Theorem p.549 gives only identity endomorphism in the localized functor category. This is a different, enhanced category from the manuscript’s bigraded PD theories. Received11December2000, revised24September2001.

author: Michael A. Mandell
title: Cochains and homotopy type
annote: Original source opened by root; Main Theorem p.213 and Theorem0.1 p.214 matched. Integral E-infinity cochains classify finite-type nilpotent spaces; functor is faithful and not full. First arXiv3November2003; online publication28June2006. Separate from Mandell2001 and2002.

author: Torsten Ekedahl
title: On minimal models in integral homotopy theory
annote: Original arXiv source opened and exact Lemma2.8 p.6, Theorem2.9 pp.6--7 read (published numbering Theorem2.7). Connected nilpotent spaces with degreewise finitely generated homology admit minimal special numerical models, unique up to numerical homotopy, not strict isomorphism. Numerical maps are integer-valued rational polynomial maps. First30June2001, revised20August2001, publication2002.

author: Bertrand Toën
title: Le problème de la schématisation de Grothendieck revisité
annote: Original full source opened. Theorem4.1 printedp11 for simply connected finite-type spaces identifies affinization homotopy sheaves with π_i(X) tensored with Hilbert additive group H. Theorem0.1 pp.2--3 gives retraction on integer points and faithfulness/object injectivity; §5 p.13 says not full. First arXiv13November2019, publication2020. No equivalence with manuscript coPD category proved.

author: Geoffroy Horel
title: Binomial rings and homotopy theory
journal: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik
annote: Current24-page author version opened. Theorem5.4 p.13: connected nilpotent finite-type spaces recovered by derived unit; Theorem6.1 p.13: Bousfield--Kan Z-completion for connected finite type generally. §8 p.19 gives full faithfulness, and Remark8.5 distinguishes Toën affinization. First arXiv4November2022; journal2024; currently opened revised author version23March2025 is distinguished from journal pagination.

author: Birgit Richter and Steffen Sagave
title: A strictly commutative model for the cochain algebra of a space
annote: Original publisher PDF opened. Theorem1.1 p.1719 uses commutative I-diagram algebras for finite sets/injections with Day convolution; homotopy colimit is E-infinity equivalent to cochains over a commutative ring. Theorem1.2 p.1720 classifies nilpotent finite-type spaces over Z. §1.4 p.1722 records failure of fullness. First arXivJanuary2018; precise day not asserted here.

author: Tom Bachmann and Robert Burklund
title: E-infinity-coalgebras and p-adic homotopy theory
annote: Published30-page source downloaded and exact Theorems1.2/8.1,1.3/8.2 inspected. Over a separably closed field of characteristic p, E-infinity coalgebra chains are fully faithful on p-complete nilpotent spaces without finite-type or connectedness assumptions. Simply connected essential image requires connective π0=k,π1=0 and solvable higher homotopy under the published Verschiebung operation. No identification with coPD coalgebras in the manuscript. First arXiv24February2024; received27June2025, accepted15December2025, published23March2026.

author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
title: Divided power algebra
annote: Exact tag opened on19November2026. Definition23.6.1 and even/odd graded extension; preserves the difference from inhomogeneous super-PD axioms.

author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
title: Koszul regular sequences
annote: Exact tag opened on19November2026. Regular implies Koszul regular; the converse requires the displayed Noetherian local/radical hypotheses.

author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
title: Lazard’s theorem
annote: Exact tag opened on19November2026. Theorem10.81.4: flat modules are directed colimits of finite free modules; exact theorem/proof read and used in flat reductions.

author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
title: Openness of the Gorenstein locus
annote: Exact tag opened on19November2026. Lemma48.25.11: flat locally finitely presented morphisms; exact theorem and proof read.

author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
title: Divided power de Rham differential
annote: Exact tag opened on19November2026. Remark60.6.7: quotient by dγ_n(x)−γ_(n−1)(x)dx and induced divided power de Rham complex.

author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
title: Flatness and localization
annote: Exact tag opened on19November2026. Localization flatness used for the explicit nonsplit acyclic flat complex; no unrelated generality imported.

author: {NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions}
title: Section 5.14: Multidimensional Integrals
annote: Equations5.14.1--5.14.2 opened. The particular simplex beta integral is also independently proved and recomputed by iterated integration in this dossier.

author: Daniel Hoffmann and Piotr Kowalski
title: Integrating Hasse--Schmidt derivations
annote: Exact arXivv3 source opened. Definition2.1 pp.2--3 identifies higher-derivation sequences with a formal algebra homomorphism; Proposition3.4/Example3.5 p.8 gives translation coefficients and their polynomial restriction. Section3.4 p.13 defines constants by all positive kernels. First23December2012, v3 revised30April2014. Related DOI10.1016/j.jpaa.2014.05.024 appears in opened arXiv metadata; exact publication pagination is not asserted. The multivariable invariant-kernel proof in this dossier is independent.

author: Shizhang Li and Shubhodip Mondal
title: On endomorphisms of the de Rham cohomology functor
annote: Opened author33-page version explicitly dated first2August2021, revised20April2022. Introduction and Theorem1.1 pp.2--3 concern smooth A-algebras, A=F_p or Z/p^n, with B an F_p-algebra, and CAlg(D(B))-valued algebraic de Rham cohomology. A semidirect endomorphism monoid for n≥2 is not the manuscript’s completed simplicial PD category. Used only to delimit a searched comparison, not as settlement of the manuscript groups. Published Geometry & Topology version surfaced in search; its exact journal pagination was not checked and is not supplied here.

author: F. Guillén Santos and V. Navarro and P. Pascual and Agustí Roig
title: Monoidal functors, acyclic models and chain operads
annote: Original publisher PDF opened. Theorem4.10 p.360 and proof, Theorem8.1 p.372, Theorem9.2 p.373 and proof pp.374--376, Corollary9.3 p.376 read; p.373 visually checked to distinguish ≥0 from faulty OCR. Theorem9.2 assumes simplexwise cochain homotopy equivalence, contractible simplicial modules in each nonnegative degree, PID base and free bidegree modules. Results concern localized monoidal functors/dg algebras, not the manuscript’s weighted τ-infinity PD category. First arXiv30June2005, revised3October2005; journal received12July2005/revised9December2005; April2008 publication. Cambridge2018 online-platform date is not first publication.
